offering_description.value: Designs and sells less-lethal personal security launchers and projectiles to consumers and public safety agencies, sold mainly through its own website and retail channels and to police and corrections agencies.

primary_products.value: personal security launchers; less-lethal projectiles; launcher accessories

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying personal security devices; B2G: police, sheriff and correctional agencies

revenue_model.value: product sales: launchers, projectiles and accessories sold to consumers and agencies

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and assembles launchers and projectiles, sold to consumers and agencies; brand owner: markets its own branded devices and accessories; retailer: sells directly online to individual consumers

geography_served.value: global: primarily United States, plus Canada and other export markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: personal security launchers and their projectiles and accessories

distribution_channels.value: online: direct sales through its own website; third-party retail: sporting goods and outdoor retailers; direct sales: law enforcement and correctional agency accounts; distributors / dealers: distributors serving international and specialty markets
distribution_channels.category: online; third-party retail; direct sales; distributors / dealers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: weapons, shipping and product safety rules under federal and state law, with state restrictions on sales and possession
